modules.title: 同一张报价列表，四种操作各自动了哪里

items.title: 创建和读取（Create / Read）
items.text: 创建是新增一条记录：表单填好客户和金额，保存后列表多出一条。读取是查看已有数据：列表展示、详情页面以及按条件检索，本质上都属于读取操作。

items.title: 更新（Update）
items.text: 修改已有记录里的信息。改金额、改跟进状态都是更新，不产生新记录。

items.title: 删除（Delete）
items.text: 移除一条记录。删除最好有确认，因为它通常不可撤销。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 增删改查是操作类别，不是存储位置——数据可以存在浏览器本地，也可以存在云端数据库，操作本身一样。登录、导出报表、数据统计都不属于这四种操作：它们要么是权限问题，要么是建立在数据之上的扩展功能。跟 AI 说需求时，用这四个词圈出范围，它就不会把工具越做越大。

lessonPractice.title: AI 说「报价工具的增删改查都做完了」。下面哪个功能不属于这四种操作？

options.label: 把报价记录导出成月度统计图
options.feedback: 对。导出和统计是建立在已有数据之上的扩展功能。四种基本操作只管每条记录本身的进出和修改。

options.label: 把一条报价的状态从「跟进中」改成「已成交」
options.feedback: 这属于更新（Update）：修改已有记录里的信息。

options.label: 删掉一条不再需要的报价记录
options.feedback: 这属于删除（Delete）：移除一条已有记录。

en.title: An AI says "the CRUD for the quote tool is done." Which feature below is NOT one of those four operations?

options.label: Exporting quotes into a monthly chart
options.feedback: Correct. Exporting and reporting are extra features built on top of the data. The four basic operations only manage each record itself.

options.label: Changing a quote's status from "following up" to "won"
options.feedback: That is Update: modifying information in an existing record.

options.label: Removing a quote record that is no longer needed
options.feedback: That is Delete: removing an existing record.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 帮我做一个客户报价列表，先把增删改查做完整：新建一条报价、打开能看到全部记录、每条能改金额和状态、能删除。数据先存在浏览器本地。统计图表这次不要做。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Build a client quote list with complete CRUD: create a quote, read the full list, update amount and status per row, and delete rows. Keep the data in browser storage for now. Skip charts this round.

learning.assumes: You have used a notes or spreadsheet app and know list content can be added and edited.
learning.outcome: You can split a tool idea into "which parts are CRUD and which are extra features," and scope the request to an AI Agent with these four words.

items.title: Create and Read
items.text: Create adds a record: fill in client and amount, save, and a new row appears. Read shows the records: list and detail pages are reads, and so are filtering and searching.

items.title: Update
items.text: Change information in an existing record. Editing amount or status updates; it creates no new record.

items.title: Delete
items.text: Remove a record. Deletion usually deserves a confirmation because it is often irreversible.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: CRUD names the operations, not the storage location—the data can live in browser storage or a cloud database while the operations stay the same. Login, exports, and analytics are not CRUD: they are permission concerns or features built on top of the data. Scope a request with these four words and the AI will not balloon the tool.

distinctions.label: Database
distinctions.text: {c:crud} names the four operations on data; {c:database} is one place where the data can live.

distinctions.label: Form
distinctions.text: {c:form} is the interface used to complete create and update; {c:crud} is the full set of data operations behind it.
